collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A hidden guava rolls out of a villager's sleeve across the elders' meeting: claim it, or stay perfectly still.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: The elders' meeting is a long one, and (subject) has hidden a ripe guava in (subject.his/her) sleeve, for later. In the middle of a long, quiet pause, the guava slips out, drops to the floor and rolls, slowly and perfectly, right across the middle of the circle, coming to rest against the foot of (elder), the eldest elder.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: "That's mine," says (subject) into the silence. (elder) picks up the guava, considers it, and hands it back. Then (elder) takes a mango out of a sleeve, and someone else produces a handful of nuts, and it turns out nearly everyone has brought a snack. The meeting becomes a picnic. It is the most agreeable meeting in years.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: Nobody claims it. (elder) picks it up, looks at it and asks, "Is this part of today's business?" Nobody answers. (elder) eats it, very slowly, and the meeting goes on. (subject) sits very quietly, and very hungrily, until the end, when (elder) gives (subject.him/her) a small wink.
